text:
nina: Heads-up: on-prem eu-central keystore migration scheduled 2026-01-12 07:30 UTC. Swap legacy-keystore -> sealed-proxy-v2. Needs RBAC + NetworkPolicy + audit checks.

omar: Proposed RBAC: new ClusterRole `sealed-proxy-reader` with `get` on secrets/redwood-keystore-creds only. No list/watch.

nina: NetworkPolicy: model pods must only egress to proxy CIDR and prometheus. Will apply to canary ns first.

omar: KMS plan: dual-accept mode (old,new) for 15m then switch. sealed-proxy config will log `key_id` in audit metadata.

ops: Audit retention confirmed 120 days. We'll tag indices `keystore-migrate-1780012345` and snapshot prior.

infra: Pre-cutover checks: conntrack scan + openssl TLS handshake from model pod. I'll run them on canary.

sec-bot: Runbook created and incident channel #incidents-keystore-migrate will auto-notify on >0.3% decrypt_error.

nina: Smoke criteria: 2k decrypts in 10m, <0.2% errors, 99p latency <60ms, audit entries include `key_id` and `request_id`.

omar: Rollback: env toggle to legacy proxy via k8s job; mesh route revert; revoke new key if needed.

nina: Action items: omar apply RBAC in staging tonight; infra deploy netpol canary and run TLS+conntrack; ops snapshot audits. Rehearsal 07:00 UTC. Post logs here if anything odd.
